title: Generative Design and Graph Neural Network Screening of Novel Bimetallic Alloy Catalysts for the Hydrogen Evolution Reaction
summary: MatterGen-generated structures and learned screening models nominated bimetallic alloy candidates; density-functional theory calculations evaluated a shortlist for hydrogen binding. Four candidates had near-thermoneutral predicted binding, but catalytic activity has not been experimentally tested.
organization: Not stated in the abstract reviewed

evidence.tested: MatterGen, MatterSim, MEGNet and ALIGNN screened candidates; plane-wave DFT found four alloys with near-thermoneutral hydrogen binding, and phonon calculations found the eight evaluated alloys dynamically stable.
evidence.unknown: No experimental catalytic activity or durability has been demonstrated; the candidates are proposed for experimental follow-up.
evidence.ai_role: MatterGen generated alloy structures; MatterSim screened/relaxed surfaces; MEGNet and ALIGNN screened adsorption candidates before DFT evaluation.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
